                   FROM twuanis_remates_private.property_terms pt

                  WHERE pt.classification_id = c.id AND pt.selected AND (t.term_type = ANY (ARRAY[$26::text, $27::text, $28::text, $29::text]))), $30, ( SELECT property_facts.exact_value::text AS exact_value

                   FROM twuanis_remates_private.property_facts pf
                  WHERE pf.classification_id = c.id AND pf.dimension = $34::text AND pf.kind = $35::text AND pf.exact_value > $36::numeric), $37,
                CASE

                     LIMIT $40), $41) AND (( SELECT count(*) AS count
                       FROM twuanis_remates_private.offering_properties single_property

                       FROM ( SELECT a.id,

                                 JOIN twuanis_remates_private.observation_fields field ON field.observation_id = a.observation_id AND field.field_path = a.field_path AND field.ordinal = a.ordinal
                              WHERE a.offering_id = o.id AND a.source_id = s.id AND a.observation_id = ob.id AND a.kind = $45::text AND link.state = $46::text AND a.field_path = $47::text AND field.validation = $48::text AND field.raw_value = a.source_url AND a.source_url ~* $49::text
                              ORDER BY a.ordinal, a.id

                    ELSE $52::jsonb

           FROM twuanis_remates_private.offering_properties op
             JOIN twuanis_remates_private.properties p ON p.id = op.property_id
             JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT cc.id,

         LIMIT $59), $60) AND (vis.value -> $61::text) = $62::jsonb), canonical_scope AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT v.id listing_id,p.id property_id,c.id classification_id,s.id source_id,ob.id observation_id,array_remove(ARRAY[
 CASE WHEN p_scope->>$63<>$64 OR v.mechanism IS DISTINCT FROM $65 OR (CASE WHEN ob.parse_status=$66 AND ob.raw_text LIKE $67 THEN ob.raw_text::jsonb->>$68 ELSE $69 END) IS DISTINCT FROM $70 THEN $71 END,
 CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT $72 FROM jsonb_each_text((p_scope->$73)||jsonb_build_object($74,p_scope->>$75)) g WHERE g.value IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT $76 FROM twuanis_remates_private.property_terms pt JOIN public.ontology_terms t ON t.id=pt.term_id WHERE pt.classification_id=c.id AND pt.selected AND t.term_type=g.key AND t.id::text=g.value)) THEN $77 END

 WHERE v.state=$84

), scope_manifest AS (SELECT jsonb_build_object($86,$87,$88,p_scope,$89,coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object($90,listing_id,$91,property_id,$92,classification_id,$93,source_id,$94,observation_id) ORDER BY listing_id,property_id) FILTER(WHERE cardinality(reasons)=$95),$96),$97,coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object($98,listing_id,$99,property_id,$100,classification_id,$101,source_id,$102,observation_id,$103,reasons) ORDER BY listing_id,property_id) FILTER(WHERE cardinality(reasons)>$104),$105)) manifest FROM canonical_scope) SELECT jsonb_build_object($106,(SELECT manifest FROM scope_manifest),$107,coalesce(jsonb_agg(item ORDER BY listing_id,property_id),$108),$109,
 (SELECT md5(jsonb_build_object($110,coalesce(jsonb_agg(v ORDER BY v.id),$111),
 $112,(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(cc.id ORDER BY cc.id),$113) FROM twuanis_remates_private.classification_versions cc JOIN twuanis_remates_private.offering_properties op ON op.property_id=cc.property_id JOIN canonical_public vp ON vp.offering_id=op.offering_id),
 $114,(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(fe.id ORDER BY fe.id),$115) FROM twuanis_remates_private.offering_events fe JOIN canonical_public vp ON vp.offering_id=fe.offering_id),

 SELECT v.id listing_id,p.id property_id,jsonb_build_object(
 $118,$119,$120,v.id,$121,p.id,$122,v.offering_id,$123,s.id,$124,s.namespace,
 $125,s.revision::text,$126,b.record_key,$127,b.id,$128,b.revision::text,
 $129,v.revision,$130,v.state,$131,c.id,$132,c.revision::text,
 $133,ob.id,$134,ob.retrieved_at,$135,ob.content_sha256,$136,pol.id,$137,pol.revision::text,

 $153,jsonb_build_object($154,fv.id,$155,fe.id,$156,fe.revision::text,$157,fv.kind,$158,fv.status,$159,fv.amount::text,$160,fv.currency,$161,fv.observation_id,$162,fv.source_id,$163,fv.offering_id,$164,fv.field_path,$165,fv.ordinal,$166,twuanis_remates_private.financial_selection_valid(fe.id)),

 $217,(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object($218,f.dimension,$219,f.kind,$220,f.exact_value::text,$221,f.category_term_id::text,$222,f.range_lower::text,$223,f.range_upper::text,$224,f.lower_inclusive,$225,f.upper_inclusive,$226,f.evidence_id,$227,f.field_path,$228,f.ordinal)), $229) FROM twuanis_remates_private.property_facts f WHERE f.classification_id=c.id AND f.dimension NOT IN($230,$231)),

 $243,(SELECT CASE WHEN eo.raw_text LIKE $244 AND eo.raw_text::jsonb->>$245=$246 THEN eo.raw_text::jsonb->$247 ELSE $248 END FROM twuanis_remates_private.observations eo WHERE eo.id=c.observation_id)
